title: Late bytes after the artifact reference is cleared are a harmless discard

rejection.rule: Clearing or replacing the reference makes late bytes harmless. A stale error for a cleared or replaced job is a harmless discard. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §8.2, §9)
rejection.effect: The phone drops the late bytes without rendering, without a protocol error, and without clearing unrelated coaching state.

summary: An available artifact is announced at revision 11, then a later state clears the visual lane at revision 12. Bytes correlated to the old reference then arrive; they are stale and harmless.

steps.note: Accepted sessionId and the visual bundle. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.2)

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

artifact.demonstrates: Move the subject one step left

steps.note: Available artifact announced at revision 11; current reference established. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §8.2)

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

steps.note: The visual lane is cleared; the artifact reference is gone. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §6, §8.2)
Bytes correlated to the cleared reference arrive late. The phone drops them harmlessly. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §8.2, §9)

outcome: No image is rendered and no protocol error is required. Unrelated coaching lanes (revision 12) remain valid.
